exposure: Magnesium sulfate combined with compound Danshen injection treatment
outcome: Pregnancy outcome (vaginal delivery rate, cesarean section rate, postpartum hemorrhage, uterine inertia, fetal distress)
Kidney function (serum creatinine, blood urea nitrogen, 24h urine protein)
Blood pressure (systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 91 patients diagnosed with early onset severe preeclampsia (EOSPE) admitted to a hospital, divided into two groups based on their treatment.
finding: Treatment with magnesium sulfate combined with compound Danshen injection significantly improved pregnancy outcome, liver and kidney functions, and vascular endothelial function in patients with early onset severe preeclampsia compared to magnesium sulfate alone.
mod_finding: The observation group receiving combined treatment had a significantly higher vaginal delivery rate (65.22%) and lower cesarean section rate (34.78%) compared to the control group (40% VD, 60% C-S).
